club.description: FC Orwell takes its name from the River Orwell, linking Ipswich to its estuary and maritime history. The club's identity reflects Suffolk's landscape and the lasting relationship between the town, its river and the communities nearby.

descriptions.de: FC Orwell trägt den Namen des Flusses Orwell und verbindet Ipswich mit seiner Flussmündung und maritimen Geschichte. Die Landschaft Suffolks und die dauerhafte Beziehung zwischen Stadt, Fluss und umliegenden Gemeinden prägen den Verein.
descriptions.es: FC Orwell toma su nombre del río Orwell y vincula Ipswich con su estuario y su historia marítima. El paisaje de Suffolk y la relación duradera entre la ciudad, el río y las comunidades cercanas definen al club.
descriptions.fr: FC Orwell tire son nom de la rivière Orwell et relie Ipswich à son estuaire et à son histoire maritime. Le paysage du Suffolk et les liens durables entre la ville, le fleuve et les communautés voisines façonnent le club.
descriptions.it: FC Orwell prende il nome dal fiume Orwell e collega Ipswich al suo estuario e alla sua storia marittima. Il paesaggio del Suffolk e il legame duraturo tra città, fiume e comunità vicine definiscono il club.
descriptions.en: FC Orwell takes its name from the River Orwell, linking Ipswich to its estuary and maritime history. The club's identity reflects Suffolk's landscape and the lasting relationship between the town, its river and the communities nearby.
